english.title: Card holder fail to notify / to surrender card where details of holder cease to be correct - tachograph cards

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Passenger and Goods Vehicles Recording Equipment Tachograph Card Regulations 2006

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been required by the Secretary of State to surrender a tachograph card, namely a

(A)_[company card,]_
(B)_[control card,]_
(C)_[driver card,]_
(D)_[workshop card,]_

which appeared to the Secretary of State to have been issued in error or with an error or omission in particulars specified in the card, failed to surrender the card
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(2), (5) and (6) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
